limitations: Structured source annotations, not treatment recommendations or medically validated facts.
Every claim is pending. Source completeness and medical validity remain unverified.
Entries the page markup describes but the saved text cannot anchor unambiguously, placeholders and group-level qualifications produce issues, not inferred facts.
Condition interactions are safety claims whose population field holds the source condition heading; they describe caution in that condition, not an indication for use.
Citation reference numbers stay verbatim in excerpts; they are not resolved to studies and some may be absent from the captured bibliography (see per-source citation reports).
Source bounds, alternatives, populations, routes and uncertainty remain in verbatim excerpts.
Unknown fields remain null; no unit/scale conversion, UMLS mapping or negative-risk inference.
Review all extracted associations against the original before clinical or safety-engine use.
